subject: Certification pathways & evidence inventory — ISO / FedRAMP pre-assessment
messages:
From: Julia Smith <julia.smith@finbank.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: External Audit (Pre-assess) <audit-pre@riskpartners.io>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ask — cert pathways and evidence inventory for ISO/FedRAMP pre-assessment

Hi Aditya / Monica,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. As we scope a potential pilot with FinBank, our security team needs a concise roadmap and an inventory of evidence for three parallel tracks: ISO 27001 (scope: inference platform), FedRAMP pre-assessment (moderate), and SIG/CAIQ answers for our procurement bucket.

Can you send:
- A short timeline (quarter-level) for ISO certification activities you expect over the next 12 months
- A single-sheet evidence inventory (CSV or spreadsheet) that maps controls to artifacts and current status (owned / in progress / missing)
- Any sample narratives for encryption/keys, logging/retention, and private deployment network boundaries we can preview

We'd like the inventory by EOD Wednesday so our procurement and audit teams can do a quick gap triage before we lock in dates for a pre-assessment.

Also: are there any known blockers (3rd-party attestations, HSM requirements, or on-prem packaging constraints) that would materially affect a FedRAMP moderate timeline?

Appreciate your help — if it's easier, propose a 30-min slot and we can triage live.

Best,
Julia Smith
Senior InfoSec Manager — FinBank
security@finbank.com

Attachment: none
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Smith <julia.smith@finbank.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — cert pathways and evidence inventory for ISO/FedRAMP pre-assessment

Julia — thanks for the clear list. High level answers first, then I'll attach the inventory template we use internally.

High level:
- ISO 27001: typical timeline is 9–12 months from formal kick-off if controls baseline exists; with current investment we can target a gap remediation sprint in Q4 and an external audit in Q2 next year.
- FedRAMP (moderate): path commonly extends 12–18 months including a pre-assessment and remediation cycles; the single biggest external variable is the need for a sponsoring agency or an ATO path (we can brief you on options).
- SIG/CAIQ: we have a maintained answers workbook; most items map to controls/evidence in our inventory.

Known constraints to flag:
- HSM/KMS: we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) in Private deployments; for hosted customers we use KMS with key separation controls. A documented HSM integration or attestation can add contractual lead time.
- 3rd-party attestations (e.g., managed monitoring): some telemetry collectors are vendor-managed; we'll enumerate those in the inventory.

I attached our 'cert-pathways-template' CSV — it's a compact mapping: control_id, requirement, artifact, owner, status, ETA. Monica will start populating with current artifacts and owners.

If you prefer a sync, we have slots Tue/Wed afternoon PST — Monica, Vivek, Priyom, and I can join.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Head of GTM Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_cert-pathways-template.csv (spreadsheet stub)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Julia Smith <julia.smith@finbank.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 08:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask — cert pathways and evidence inventory for ISO/FedRAMP pre-assessment

Julia / team — attaching a first-pass inventory extract and a brief scope diagram (ISO boundaries) for your triage. Key notes inline:

Attachment list: sig-caiq-inventory-draft.xlsx; iso-scope-diagram.pdf

Highlights from the inventory (rows represent control buckets):
- Encryption / KMS: Owner = Platform Infra; artifacts = KMS config export, key rotation policy, access matrix (status: owned)
- Logging & Retention: Owner = Observability; artifacts = ELK retention config, snapshot policy, dryrun export (status: in progress — retention policy doc queued)
- Private deployment isolation: Owner = Private Deployments; artifacts = VPC architecture diagram, HSM integration notes (status: partial — HSM POC scheduled)
- SOC2 evidence: we have prior attestations for underlying infra components; Redwood-wide SOC2 report is in preparation (ETA: end of Q1 next year)

Action owners I've assigned in the sheet: Vivek (KMS/HSM narrative), Priyom (network boundaries + FedRAMP control mapping), Aditya (procurement/SIG narrative).

Open asks for FinBank team:
1) Any specific CAIQ sections you want prioritized? (e.g., Data Protection, Infrastructure, or Access Control)
2) For FedRAMP, confirm whether you expect us to pursue an agency ATO or an LZ via a marketplace — that affects the audit sequencing.

I'll iterate on the spreadsheet today and push a second version by 3pm PST. If it's useful, we can do a 30-min gap triage at 4pm.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Initial ask — cert pathways and evidence inventory for ISO/FedRAMP pre-assessment

Monica — thanks, this is exactly what we needed for the first pass. The inventory format is great; a couple of quick follow-ups before our internal triage:

- Can you surface a short narrative (1–2 paragraphs) on how you separate customer data in the hosted prod environment vs private deployment? We want a clear statement for procurement.
- For KMS/HSM: please highlight whether you offer customer-managed keys for hosted (BYOK) or only in Private; also include any 3rd-party HSM vendors you currently support.
- For the FedRAMP question: our procurement lead prefers the agency ATO route but will confirm — we flagged both options in internal notes.

I'll route this to our procurement and schedule a quick internal triage tomorrow morning. If everything looks aligned we'll propose a 30-min pre-assessment slot with RiskPartners in the next two weeks.

Appreciate the rapid turnaround.

Best,
Julia
Senior InfoSec Manager — FinBank
